t: What Chemical Separation Database Is All About
title: What Chemical Separation Database Is All About
description: Separations exploit differences: distillation uses boiling points, extraction uses solubilities, chromatography uses affinities, filtration uses size. Crude oil becomes gasoline, diesel, and asphalt in a fractional distillation column — each fraction condensing at its own tray temperature. The method follows the mixture: know what differs between components, and the separation designs itself. This database is the complete separation method: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.

t: Core Vocabulary of Chemical Separation Database
title: Core Vocabulary of Chemical Separation Database
description: Every field has its own language. These are the working terms of Chemical Separation Database — learn them first and every later record reads faster: partition coefficient: solute ratio between two phases; reflux: condensed vapor returned to the column; theoretical plate: one equilibrium stage of separation; eluent: mobile phase in chromatography.
definition: The working vocabulary of Chemical Separation Database: the terms practitioners actually use.
key_points: partition coefficient: solute ratio between two phases
reflux: condensed vapor returned to the column
theoretical plate: one equilibrium stage of separation
eluent: mobile phase in chromatography
permeate: fluid passing through a membrane
azeotrope: mixture distilling unchanged
